:::{#def-weighted-average}
#### Weighted average, weighted mean

A **weighted average** (or **weighted mean**) of the [numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a_1, \ldots, a_k$
is a [weighted sum](#def-weighted-sum) of them
whose [weights](#def-weight) $w_1, \ldots, w_k$ are non-negative and add to $1$:

$$
\sumto{i}{k} w_i a_i
\quad\text{with}\quad
w_i \ge 0 \text{ for each } i
\quad\text{and}\quad
\sumto{i}{k} w_i = 1
$$

An $a_i$ with a larger [weight](#def-weight) counts for more.

:::
